Our office met with the General Manager of Selden Mast in North Charleston to tour their facility and discuss opportunities to strengthen local manufacturing.

Selden builds boats from the deck up and is a leading manufacturer of complete sail-handling systems and deck hardware for dinghies, keelboats, and yachts up to 80 feet.

Supporting local manufacturers like Selden is critical to keeping American manufacturing competitive and sustaining good-paying jobs.
